unknowns: Wholesale discount, payment terms, credit limits and inbound freight: no primary number exists

actual_result: Worked: ~$17,000 of stock turned $511,000 of ship-basis sales (DERIVED 3.33%), but only up to 400,000 of the >1,000,000 advertised titles were distributor-fillable on a 1997 disclosure

actual_result: The claim was made and repeated; Barnes & Noble contested the 'Earth's biggest bookstore' wording only in January 1997 (post-boundary); no 1995 fill-rate measurement exists
